novelty_flags.label: Theorem 3: feasibility boundary
novelty_flags.one_line: The claimed Hölder-margin minimax exponent is the published Perchet--Rigollet Theorem 5.1 rate; replacing bounded rewards by unit Gaussian regression is a routine tail-model transfer, not a standalone novelty contribution.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 5.1 gives regret of order n(K log K/n)^{beta(alpha+1)/(2 beta+d)} for finite alpha and identifies it as minimax-optimal for two arms; Proposition 3.1 supplies the alpha beta <= d implication for finite alpha.
The paper proves a finite-arm treatment-effect estimation-error versus regret product lower bound, gives its Pareto criterion, and supplies EXP3E finite-sample attainment.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 713--742, abstract and optimal-value inference results
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies inference for the optimal-treatment mean, proves a pathwise-differentiability characterization, and develops root-n inference under stated conditions; it does not optimize adaptive data collection under a welfare budget.

The paper gives one-sided lower confidence bands for optimal welfare, relates first-order dominance to non-uniform margin separation, and constructs procedures robust to margin-condition failure; it does not solve two-sided budgeted sequential width optimization.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Move the Perchet--Rigollet feasibility exponent from a claimed new theorem into a cited sanity-reduction lemma, and reserve theorem status for a genuinely new budget-to-width implication.

State at least one explicit candidate Hölder-margin branch, with its lower-bound bump calibration and the proposed budget threshold, so the complete-frontier OEQ has a falsifiable rate target rather than only a modulus-equivalence target.

Develop the dyadic handle into a specified predictable allocation rule and prove a cellwise count-versus-welfare-price lemma; this would convert the new full-frontier kernel into a concrete upper-bound program.

recommended_next_step: Revise by demoting Theorem 3 to a cited reduction, then advance the genuinely novel complete welfare-budgeted honest-width frontier to Stage 0.
